description: Buy a usage top-up pack with the card on file and continue. THIS CHARGES MONEY: name the pack and its price to the user and get a yes before calling. Omit pack for the smallest pack; ids and prices come from frontrun_billing or the out_of_usage error. Credits this key at once, so retry the original call after. If no card is on file the answer is a checkout_url to hand to the user. Set auto_refill true to buy the same pack automatically whenever usage runs low, so the session never stalls again. At most 3 purchases per key per day.

auto_refill.description: Also turn on auto-refill with this pack for this key. Default false.

pack.description: Pack id from frontrun_billing (e.g. the "popular" one). Omit for the smallest pack.

name: frontrun_topup
